note.question: What determines the value of CST to learn supply chain (demand) information and the impact of CST on IOIT?
note.overview: Recently, firms in supply chains have begun to deploy popular mobile apps (e.g., WeChat) into their supply chain practices to improve demand visibility. These efforts rely on consumers to scan the products they purchase using these apps, which we refer to as consumer scanning technology (CST). CST can be an alternative to the conventional interorganizational information technology (IOIT) that relies on collaboration between supply chain firms.

components.formal: Information structure: Because retailers’ information loss can play a significant role in the adoption of IOIT, we incorporate this factor into our model.
conditions: Instead of modeling a specific mechanism, we model the information loss by a constant γ which captures a possible disincentive for the retailer to share information.
However, it has been observed that retailers are often unwilling to share demand information because they can suffer a loss (called information loss) by doing so.
We also assume the supplier knows the value of γ through possible communications or negotiations for IOIT adoption with the retailer.
